summary: Request: Reorg Model-Eval Slack channels, apply retention tags, and consolidate Confluence spaces
description:
Issue summary: Model-Eval pod is requesting a targeted reorganization of their Slack workspace and Confluence spaces to reduce noise, enforce retention tags for PII-sensitive channels, and consolidate three small spaces into one scoped space.

Impact: Ongoing confusion about where canonical docs live; duplicated pages across three Confluence spaces; multiple low-traffic channels in #model-eval that contain user PII in ephemeral posts. This increases operational overhead and raises audit/compliance risk for upcoming SOC assessment.

Environment: Redwood Slack org (workspace id: prod), Confluence cloud (tenant: redwood-inference), affected spaces: Model-Eval Drafts, Model-Eval Team Notes, Model-Eval Experiments.

Requested outcome: 1) Split #model-eval into #model-eval-announcements (read-only for leads) and #model-eval-discuss (active), migrate long-lived threads into Confluence where appropriate. 2) Apply 90-day retention tag to channels flagged as containing PII/QA logs, and archive channels with <5 members and no activity in 6+ months. 3) Consolidate the three Confluence spaces into a single "Model Eval" space with preserved page history and a short TOC; add access groups and set two-space owners. 4) Provide a short runbook describing post-migration edit workflow and link to compliance evidence for auditors.
steps_to_execute: Inventory: run workspace audit and export channel list for #model-eval prefix and Model-Eval-related channels.
Stakeholder signoff: send consolidation proposal to Model-Eval leads (CC: Pod manager, Security) and collect approval.
Slack actions: create #model-eval-announcements and #model-eval-discuss, migrate pinned items and important threads into Confluence pages (use channel export for threads beyond pin limits).
Retention settings: apply 90-day retention to channels tagged 'pii' and apply archiving policy to channels with low engagement.
Confluence actions: create target 'Model Eval' space, copy/merge pages preserving edit history where possible, deprecate old spaces with redirect pages.
Access & owners: create groups model-eval-read, model-eval-edit; assign space permissions and set two space admins.
Runbook & evidence: publish a 1-page migration runbook and capture screenshots/config for compliance record.
Post-cleanup verification: run search queries for duplicate pages and confirm no broken links; request signoff from pod leads.
impact: Medium - affects documentation discoverability and increases compliance risk if PII remains in Slack channels; no production downtime.
